The '''Regal Bothan Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Sharalon]] served as the hotel's main desk manager, a cover for [[Gender/Legends|her]] true [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] role.
